vcs.note: Initialised 2026-08-13, origin Coreword/coreagent, default branch main. worktree_manifest_sha256 stays in the handover fingerprint alongside any commit SHA: a commit SHA cannot see uncommitted working-tree drift, which is exactly the state an agent hands over in.

invariants: Never edit vendor/ or node_modules/ directly.
All schema changes go through a migration; never hand-edit database/database.sqlite.
Never commit .env, and never copy a value out of it into .agent/.
Private keys live only under C:/ClaudeProfiles/<agent-id>/ and never under .agent/.
